slides.heading: Updating List Items
slides.body: Updating List Items is part of Lists and Mutable Sequences. This short lesson gives you a practical Python idea you can understand, try, and reuse in simple programs.

slides.heading: Core Idea: Updating List Items
slides.body: Lists are mutable, meaning their items can be changed after the list is created. Use an index to update a specific item.

slides.heading: Real-World Analogy
slides.body: Updating a list item is like replacing one entry on a whiteboard without rewriting the whole board.

slides.heading: Key Rule
slides.body: Lists use square brackets, zero-based indexes, and can be changed after creation.
